claims: The 45th Annual Dallas St. Patrick's Parade & Festival is on Saturday, March 14, 2026.
The 45th Annual Dallas St. Patrick's Parade & Festival is along Greenville Avenue.
The parade starts at 11 AM at Blackwell Street.
The parade ends at SMU Blvd around 2 PM.
The surrounding festival runs 9 AM–3 PM.
The parade proceeds down Greenville Avenue from Park Lane to SMU Boulevard.
The event features the St. Patrick's Day Dash 5K.
The Lower Greenville St. Patrick's Day Block Party occurs near the parade route.
Major road closures include Greenville Avenue from Park Lane to Mockingbird Lane.
CBS News and dallasstpp.com say attendees are encouraged to use DART, specifically the Park Lane or Lovers Lane stations.
The Lower Greenville Block Party is for ages 21+.
The Lower Greenville Block Party requires a cash entry fee.
